_note: All eight checks need nothing more than the cluster's Metrics API (per-Pod CPU), which requires cluster monitoring to be running — enabled on the CRC test cluster on 2026-09-11 (two CVO overrides removed) plus user-workload monitoring. Without it every HPA utilisation figure reads <unknown> and the HPA never leaves minReplicas, so the four metrics-dependent checks fail loudly rather than being skipped. imagePullPolicy=Always forces a re-pull of the mutable samples/hello-dcs:1.0 tag. The two scale-out checks carry timeout: 300 — they wait internally (~2 min) and on a loaded cluster the per-oc-call latency pushes them past the 180s default, which killed them before their diagnostic could print (runs 3-5). The load is ab (ApacheBench, in the session image) detached for 900s: measured in a live session, 8-12 parallel curl loops drove the app to only 2-13% of its 100m request under cluster churn (fork + DNS per request, inside the 500m session container), so the HPA correctly never scaled; one ab -c 16 process reached 57-71% and the HPA scaled 1->3 in under a minute (verified end-to-end on Dev 2026-10-01).

steps.run: envsubst < deployment.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc apply -f service.yaml && oc patch deployment/hello-dcs --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/imagePullPolicy","value":"Always"}]' && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=180s
( ab -t 900 -c 16 "http://hello-dcs.$(oc project -q).svc:8080/" >/dev/null 2>&1 & ); echo "ab load running detached for 900s"
